About us

Skin art, rooted in tradition

Welcome to MilliMehndhi, named after my beloved grandma and my favourite thing to do. Here tradition meets artistry.

My journey began in childhood, inspired by watching other's intricate henna work, leading me to hone my craft from paper sketches to intricate client designs.

Driven by a commitment to quality and wellness, I exclusively use premium organic henna for all bookings, offering custom patterns that bring beauty, balance, and elegance to every occasion.

Looking after your design

Aftercare

Keep your mehndhi on for as long as possible.

Seal it

Once dried, apply an equal-parts lemon juice and white sugar mixture with a cotton ball to prevent crumbling.

Avoid covering it

Do not cover with cling film or bags, as sweat will smudge the design.

Clove steam

After sealing, hover the area over a warm pan of cloves to darken the stain. Repeat a few times.

No water

Scrape the paste off to remove it. Do not wash it off. Avoid water contact for 24 hours.

Post-removal

Apply Vicks to the area and repeat the clove steaming.
